You can see something run today without spending anything. Two free options:

- **`weave test main.loom --coverage`** runs your workflow's scripted tests with scripted models. No key, no network, no cost. It shows the routes being taken.
- **`weave try`** runs a bundled demo workflow on demo models and explains each step. It does not run your script.

A real run on your three agents (Researcher, Writer, Editor) comes after preflight, which hasn't run yet. It is capped at 200,000 tokens and 30 calls. A local Ollama model is also free per call, if you install it first.

Skipping the golden dataset means no pass rate. One real answer shows you what it can do, not how often it is right. I can record the skip so it's on the record, or we can start with the free tests now. Which would you like?
